s.note: the Spenglers living in the old firehouse
s.how: Stretch pizza dough thin on a big tray. Spread with pizza sauce, scatter with grated mozzarella, pepperoni and a pinch of oregano. Bake at 250C for 10 minutes until bubbling. Cut into squares and eat straight from the tray at the firehouse.
Blitz 2 avocados with 200g thawed peas, the juice of 2 limes, a handful of mint and salt until smooth and very green. Spoon into a bowl and serve with corn chips for scooping. Slimy in the best way.

m.how: Mix mayonnaise with a little tomato sauce and chopped pickle for dressing. Layer rye bread with sliced corned beef, sauerkraut, Swiss cheese and dressing. Butter the outsides and grill in a pan until golden and melting. Cut in half to serve.

w.note: the tiny marshmallow men causing chaos
w.how: Toast marshmallows over a flame or under a hot grill until golden and gooey. Sandwich each between two plain sweet biscuits with a square of dark chocolate, squashing so the chocolate melts. Eat them before they start causing trouble.

d.how: Heat 1L milk until steaming. Whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate until smooth and frothy. Pour into mugs and top each with whipped cream and a handful of mini marshmallows. Perfect for a city frozen solid in summer.
